system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You can provide custom instructions that are injected into the system prompt on every session.
system_prompt_style.note: Global + project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files merged, plus per-phase role directives generated from role configuration.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: In single-model mode the orchestration system prompt (environment, tools, research rules, guidelines, phase tagging) stays active, but task classification and delegation are disabled.
env_context_strategy.note: Excerpts show a terminal coding agent with an explore phase/explorer role and bash tools; no up-front file-tree or retrieval injection is described. Inferred from prose; no line numbers available in the excerpt. MCP ripgrep/filesystem servers can be migrated (opt-in).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: This compresses command output (git, cargo, npm, docker, etc.) by 60-90%, reducing LLM context usage.
context_compaction.note: Also read tool 'truncates intelligently' per docs/bash-tool-guard.md.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
The harness truncates intelligently, shows line numbers, can request
specific offsets/limits.
observation_format.note: Vision metadata field exists for models but no image observation source documented.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: When the LLM calls `Agent({ subagent_type: "expert-coder", prompt: "...", description: "..." })`:

tool_count.note: Seven built-in tools; plus Agent/subagent tools, 5 LSP tools, ferment tools, web_fetch/web_search and MCP tools when configured.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
`edit` (in-place `sed -i` corrupts files on regex
mismatches) and `write` (`echo > file` overwrites with no diff, no

edit_primitive.note: edit tool = string replacement, write = full file; exact semantics inferred from docs.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Discovered MCP servers are merged into `~/.config/kimchi/harness/mcp.json`.
tool_schema_source.note: Agent personas are hand-written markdown with YAML frontmatter; MCP schemas fetched from servers.

protocol_standardization.note: ACP (JSON-RPC over stdio) mode also shipped: 'acp/ -- JSON-RPC over stdio (IDE integration)'.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: For each pipeline phase (plan, build, review, explore, research), the system prompt tells the orchestrator exactly what to do
loop_primitives.note: Default multi-model orchestration runs a phase pipeline; retry after a standard-tier model has failed.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Ferment persists a structured plan (goal, phases, steps) as a JSON state file.
planning_granularity.note: Ferment mode is opt-in (--ferment); default sessions use phase tagging only.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The orchestrator delegates each task to the model assigned for that role
multi_agent_topology.note: Multi-model mode; single-model mode disables delegation.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
The
LLM can spawn specialized agents via the `Agent` tool — each runs as a focused
child session with its own system prompt, model, and tool restrictions.

human_in_loop.note: on_plan from ferment manual policy: 'Ask before moving to the next phase'.

short_term_state.note: Ferment snapshot; plain sessions are conversation logs.

long_term_memory.note: Skills: resources/skills/ and 'skills: <bool|csv> # true (inherit) | false | comma-list of skill names to preload'.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: On next start, the harness reads this entry and resumes from the exact state.

self_verification.evidence_quote: `lsp_diagnostics` | Get type errors, warnings, and linter diagnostics for a file
self_verification.note: Review is always delegated to a reviewer model (llm_judge); critic persona gives self_critique.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: escalates to heavy-tier only for complex work (concurrency, algorithms) or as a retry after a standard-tier model has failed

rollback.evidence_quote:
`write` (`echo > file` overwrites with no diff, no
review, no recovery)
rollback.note: No undo/revert/snapshot mechanism documented in README or docs.

termination_condition.note: Ferment automated policy: 'Keep going until complete, blocked, paused, or user input is needed'; 30-min hard cap is a per-run timeout.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: the orchestrator picks the lightest-tier model that fits the task
cost_controls.note: budget-retry-guard.ts / worker-budget-policy.ts in src/extensions/agents/manager suggest budget caps.

timeouts.evidence_quote: omit for unlimited (pi's 30-min hard cap still applies)

execution_isolation.note: Local terminal CLI operating on the working tree; `/teleport` can move the session to a cloud sandbox (remote).

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Rsync working tree to a cloud sandbox and foreground it
filesystem_access.note: Local CLI with bash/read/write/edit tools on the host filesystem; no path allowlist documented.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Kimchi respects `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` environment variables for network requests.
network_policy.note: No egress restriction documented; web_fetch/web_search shipped.

permission_model.note: Hooks can additionally 'rewrite or block shell commands before they run'.

tracing.evidence_quote:
Anything that could include user data or secrets inline

replayability.evidence_quote: Every mutation is persisted as an append-only event with pre/post state hashes, enabling full auditability.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The `benchmark/` directory contains tools for smoke-testing kimchi sessions and auditing their quality.

guardrails.note: output_filters: telemetry payloads keep raw command text out of OTLP; bash-tool-guard blocks/steers calls.
